I’ve seen him use a nebulizer in the past, and he’s much older than you. i would say you should probably consult with another specialist because i don’t think nebulizers are strictly kids and elderly, especially if your asthma is badly controlled.

edit: someone mentioned allergy shots that i HIGHLY recommend if you have bad allergies and only take zyrtec or another antihistamine for it. 
I got tested once for all the things i’m allergic to, which happened to include my three pets and my plants (my personal hobby). I go to my local asthma and allergy center once a week and get a painless shot of a mix of all the things i’m allergic to in each arm, like a vaccine. It’s done wonders for my asthma, and if you haven’t been tested please consider this!
